metadata.task_name: Error Message Disclosure and Debug Logging

execution.coverage: 100% — all four target files plus app.module.ts for logger configuration

finding.preliminary_assessment: WebLoginComponent.handleError() logs raw server error messages via console.error() and binds them directly to the DOM. Server error messages from ApplinX REST API may contain internal server paths, stack traces, database details, or user data that aid reconnaissance. The browser console is accessible to any JavaScript running on the same origin (including XSS payloads) and is captured in browser DevTools. Multiple other console.log() calls were found in MacroComponent (lines 231, 235, 239, 272) logging macro names, API responses, and error objects. Note: VULN-012 (AuthTokenServerService) is CORRECTLY implemented — Bearer token is NOT added to remote NGX Logger HTTP requests. The remote log endpoint is secured. However, local console.error() calls remain and the errorMessage DOM binding allows server error content to be rendered in the UI with style='white-space: pre-line' preserving line breaks.

patterns_observed: console.error(msg) in webLogin.handleError() — raw server error message
console.log() at lines 231, 235, 239, 272 in MacroComponent — macro names and API responses
errorMessage DOM binding with white-space: pre-line — line breaks preserved in rendered error
AuthTokenServerService.alterHttpRequest() correctly strips Bearer token — GOOD
NGX Logger serverLogLevel=ERROR (safe default) but operator-configurable
AbstractUserExits error handlers log full HttpErrorResponse objects via this.logger.error()

false_positives.rationale: VULN-012 fix correctly implemented — AuthTokenServerService strips Bearer token from all remote log requests
Angular's {{ }} interpolation provides HTML entity encoding — errorMessage DOM binding is XSS-safe; risk is information disclosure only

analysis.coverage_assessment: Complete — 31 console.log/error/warn calls identified across src/app/ and assessed for data sensitivity. Logger infrastructure configuration in app.module.ts verified. Remote endpoint security confirmed.

for_inquisitor: Determine if ApplinX REST API error responses contain server paths, stack traces, or database details
Verify whether operator-configurable serverLogLevel can be set to TRACE via sessionConfig.json
Check if CRLF sequences in server error messages cause log injection in log aggregator
Evaluate whether console.log() calls should be removed in production builds (Angular build optimization flag)
